tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'i snying po nyams su len tshul 'di phyi'i re smon kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na moḥgu ru sarba bha ga wān ta thā ga ta arha te samyaksaṃ buddhe bhyaḥ 'dir tshegs chung la phan yon shin tu che ba'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'i snying po chag med du nyams su len par 'dod pas thog mar/ skyabs 'gro tshad med sems bskyed bya ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// dwangs 'dod yid ches sgo nas skyabs su mchi// chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa// yin kyang de ltar ma rtogs sems can rnams// bde dang ldan gyur sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms gnas par shog /sems can don du sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du bde gshegs 'khor bcas la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul ba dang*// smon lam khyad par can rnams gdab par bgyi// zhes pa rnams lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro tshad med sems bskyed pa byas la/ de nas/ skyabs gsum bden dang chos dbyings dag pa'i mthus// gnas 'dir rnam dag zhing mchog nyid gyur te// khang bzang khri dang padma'i gdan dag dang*// ma tshang med pa'i mchod pas mdzes gyur cig /zhes pa lan gcig gis gnas la sogs par byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ shar phyogs rnam dag zhing gi rgyal ba bdun// mi mjed 'dren pa skyob pa shākya'i tog /kun kyang rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas// spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drangs te bzhugs par bsam/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig brgya la sogs pa bya zhing*/

de bzhin du phyag 'tshal lo man rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang padmas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang ba brtul zhugs grub pa la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal po la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la= ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sum khri drug stong dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo sogs sbyar ba 'di rnams lan mang du brjod la/ de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa skyabs grol la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i dge bsnyen thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis po re re la yang g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin bdun 'bum bdun 'bum dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa rnams lan gcig brjod/ de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dang bdug spos/

mar me dang zhal zas/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang*/ phyogs bcur bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste 'bul lo mchod do// ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang*/ bdag cag gi thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas 'khor pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ni ma bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron ma gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// zhes brjod do// de nas/ bde gshegs bdun gyis rang gi mtshan smos pa'i// phan yon ji snyed smon lam gyis grub pa// de dag bdag la bde blag 'grub gyur cig /rnam dag zhing rnams su yang skye bar shog /ston pa shākya'i gtso bos mdo sde las// ji skad gsungs pa'i phan yon byin rlabs kyi// bde gshegs gsung rab gzhan du mi 'gyur ba// de yi bden pa'ang bdag la mngon gyur mdzod// 'jam dpal skyabs grol phyag na rdo rje dang*// tshangs la sogs dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kyis// zhal bzhes ji lta'i dge legs ji snyed pa// 'phral dang yun du bdag la 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod do// spro na gzungs ring thung ji ltar rigs pa'ang bzla/

'di lta bu'i nyams len zhag re bzhin chag med du byed pa 'di la mdo nas bshad pa'i phan yon rnams gdon mi za bar 'byung nges pas/ yon tan 'dod pa rnams kyis tshegs chung zhing don che ba'i zab mo'i gnad 'di la 'bad par bya'o// de nas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa'ang bya'o// ces sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga snying po nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge 'di phyi'i re smon kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang po bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho nyid slar bzlas te byon pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mus pa

mus chen rdo rje 'chang*/ chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin bslu med kyi bla ma dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul la spyi bos reg pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang nyid kyang chos tshul 'di la mchog tu dad pas 'di lta bu'i yi ge zhig byed 'dod yod kyang*/ le lo'i dbang gis 'gyangs pa la dus phyis tshe'i rig byed kyi gzhung dang lag len kun la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa rtsa brgyad pa mgon bsam gyis rgyun gyi nyams len khyer bde ba'i mchod chog zhig dgos pa'i bskul ma byung bas rkyen byas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin legs par rab tu btus shing*/ rang nyid kyi rtog bzo'i bsre bslad spangs te 'brug lo zla ba lnga pa'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa la mkhas shing yi ge'i 'du byed la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so// 'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste// bstan pa rgyas shing phyi ma lhan cig tu// dag pa'i zhing skyes 'gro kun rjes 'dzin shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig thams cad du dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ /sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po shin tu bsdus pa phan bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhai ṣa dzye rā dzā ya/ de la 'dir sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po phyag mchod smon lam shin tu mdor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ rten gyi drung du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams la/ nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs kyi skyabs sems lan gsum dang*/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ mchog bden rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag pa'i mthus// snod bcud bde can zhing gi bkod pa'i gzhir// yid 'phrog rin chen las grub gzhal med khang*// de dbus seng khri padma'i gdan gyi steng*// bde gshegs 'khor bcas gdan 'dzom bzhugs nas kyang*// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i// mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cig /ces pas sa gzhi sogs byin gyis brlab/ spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyang 'don/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ces gsol bas mngon sum lta bur byon zhing bzhugs par bsams la/ 'byon legs sogs rgyas par bya ba'am/ yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon rgya mtshos mchod// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol zhing*// srab 'jam lha yi reg byas bsnyen bkur bgyi// bsod nams zhing du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i mthar phyag mchod dngos ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi// 'char ka'i padma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba'i// lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas// lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi mdo chog gi /lam bzang gsal mdzad dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas des gsungs dam pa'i chos// de 'dzin dge 'dun bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med// chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub// rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la// dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku// gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa'i// ston pa mtshan legs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen zla dang padmas rab brgyan cing*// shes bya kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas// rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' ba'i// sgra dbyangs rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// dzambu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba// nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar// dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku// gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo// mya ngan 'das shing bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba sel mdzad cing*// 'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa yi// mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sgra chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms// rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' zhing*// 'gro ba'i dug gsum ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i tshul// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la rol mdzad cing*// shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po// mngon mkhyen rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// kun 'byung mun pa'i sa bon mthar mdzad cing*// sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin// rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs// theg gsum dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal gzhon nu skyabs grol gsang ba'i bdag

/tshangs dang brgya byin 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi// gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis sogs// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag skyob pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i// bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas la skyabs su mchi// dngos su bshams dang gzungs dang rig pa dang*// mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod sprin ni// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las byung ba// nam mkha'i pha mthar khyab pas rtag tu mchod// thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor bzhin yun du bzhugs par gsol// bsod nams bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// bde gshegs brgyad dang rigs gsum sems dpa' sogs// bcom ldan gdan 'dzom chen po 'khor bcas kyis// bdag dang snyigs ma'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la// thugs rje chen pos lhag par nyer dgongs te// ji ltar sngon tshe smon lam dam bcas bzhin// bden pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum snang mdzad nas// gnas skabs nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung sogs// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor dad brtson shes rab sogs// mthun rkyen legs tshogs mtha' dag rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan bshad sgrub bstan pa dar// 'gro kun bde skyid 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe yi mthar yang bcom ldan sras bcas kyis// dag pa'i zhing du mngon sum khrid pa dang*// myur du byang chub snying por lung bstan nas// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol// ces phyag dang bcas te lan ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ spro na gzungs ring thung gang 'os bzlas mthar/ rten yod na nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs sogs spyi ltar dang*/ med na/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor nyams pa sogs// nongs pa gang mchis bzod par bzhes nas kyang*// bcom ldan 'khor bcas rang rang zhing khams su// gshegs te slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cig

/sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bde gshegs brgyad dang des gsungs dam pa'i chos// de 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas pa la// rmad byung dge mtshan ji snyed mchis pa des// srid zhi'i legs tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// zhes pa'ang kun mkhyen bo dong pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rab 'byams smra ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis lha rdzas kyi me tog dang bcas te gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ snyom las pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal ldan bsam 'grub chos sdings kyi chos grwar sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun don gnyis yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
